full_details: In the morning Richard cut a stick to your hip, and you followed that measure. Anne would not say where you were going. Your first walk since Tuesday was her arm and the pace of a funeral. At the corner by the Guild Chapel she asked again what she had asked at Shottery in April. You said you work in London and do not live there. She turned you. The great house stood across the lane, brick and timber, a broken pane, nettles at the gate. You asked no one whose it was, and you made no inquiry. You asked for three years. She will give you till she believes you. Home again, you said she had picked it before you had the wit to want it.
one_sentence: You walked as far as the house by the chapel, on a stick Richard cut, and Anne named the house.
title: The great house by the chapel
